scenes: Dorothy lived on the wide gray prairie of Kansas, with Aunt Em, Uncle Henry, and her little dog, Toto.
Toto, one day, let's go somewhere full of colors!
A cyclone is coming! Everybody, down to the cellar!
Before Dorothy could reach the cellar, the wind lifted the whole house, up, up, up into the sky!
Oh, Toto. I don't think we're in Kansas anymore.
Hooray! Welcome to the land of Oz!
Thank you. But please, I need to get home.
Hello, Dorothy. I am Glinda, the Good Witch.
These silver shoes are for you. They are very special. But be careful: the Wicked Witch of the West wants them!
Follow the road of yellow bricks to the Emerald City. The great Wizard of Oz can help you.
Excuse me! Could you help me down?
Thank you! I wish I had a brain. My head is only full of straw.
Come with us! The Wizard can help you. We'll go together!
I know! He needs that oil can, by his foot!
Ahh, I can move again! Thank you, clever friend. I wish I had a heart.
Come with us. We'll go together!
Oh, please don't bark at me! I'm just a scaredy-cat. I wish I had courage.
Careful, Tin Woodman! Your tears will make you rusty!
Don't be sad, Lion. Come with us. We'll go together!
Side by side, the friends walked down the road of yellow bricks.
The Wizard will help all of us!
I am Oz, the Great and Mighty! Why have you come?
Please, I want to go home. And my friends want a brain, a heart, and courage.
First, make the Wicked Witch of the West go away!
Don't worry. We can do it, together!
Those silver shoes will be mine! Fly, my monkeys!
But the monkeys carried Dorothy and Toto away to the yellow castle.
Don't worry, I have a plan! Follow me!
Hee hee! That silver shoe is mine!
Oh no! I'm melting, melting away!
Dorothy! We came to save you!
You came! Thank you, my friends!
Back in the Emerald City, Toto knocked over a screen.
You're just a little old man!
Yes, I'm sorry. But listen. Who thought of the oil can? Who cried for the Lion? Who roared at the monkeys to save Dorothy?
You had a brain, a heart, and courage all along!
Dorothy, your silver shoes can take you home. Just click your heels three times.
Goodbye, my friends. I'll never forget you!
Take me home to Aunt Em!
Oh, Aunt Em! Oz was wonderful... but there's no place like home.
